job.title: Application Analyst
job.description:

Key Responsibilities
  • Assist with the administration and support of business applications and ticketing systems.
  • Process and maintain user access requests in line with security and approval requirements.
  • Create, modify, review and deactivate user accounts.
  • Monitor, triage, categorise and assign application support tickets.
  • Provide first-level support and resolve routine application issues where appropriate.
  • Escalate complex issues to senior team members and vendors.
  • Assist with testing and validation of application changes, upgrades and enhancements.
  • Develop and maintain user guides, procedures, knowledge articles and support documentation.
  • Document business processes, system configurations and support procedures.
  • Conduct research into application functionality, best practices and emerging technologies.
  • Assist with analysis and research to support business improvements and Applications Team initiatives.
About You
  • Information Technology
  • Information Systems
  • Business Information Systems
  • or a related discipline.
You will also bring:
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

  • A customer-focused approach with strong interpersonal skills.
  • The ability to work collaboratively within a team.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications.

  • Strong hands-on experience testing Payroll and Time & Attendance solutions.
  • Direct experience with SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central (EC).

  • Strong hands-on experience testing Payroll and Time & Attendance solutions.
  • Direct experience with SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central (EC).

  • Strong understanding of payroll processes, including payroll calculations, employee master data and payroll-related integrations.
  • Experience designing and executing end-to-end, integration, functional and regression testing.
  • Strong experience in test planning, test case development, execution and defect management.

job.title: Change Manager - Workday
job.description:
Change Manager - Workday Implementation
 
We are seeking an experienced Change Manager to support our client with a major Workday implementation, supporting approximately 2,000 employees through the introduction of a new HRIS.
 
This is a key role within a significant HR transformation program, responsible for developing and executing the change strategy, ensuring stakeholder readiness, supporting adoption and helping deliver the intended business outcomes.
 
Key Responsibilities
  • Lead the end-to-end change management workstream for the Workday implementation.
  • Develop and execute change management strategies, plans and programs aligned with project requirements.
  • Conduct change impact assessments and change readiness activities.
  • Lead workshops, forums and information sessions to support the change journey.
  • Work closely with project teams to ensure coordinated change and communication activities.
  • Partner with business stakeholders to support impacted teams through the transition.
  • Develop and execute stakeholder engagement and communication strategies.
  • Use data and insights to assess adoption, identify gaps and drive sustained behavioural and process change.
  • Provide change updates and recommendations to executives and project sponsors.
  • Coordinate change activities with external implementation partners where required.
  • Develop change tools and resources to support future transformation initiatives.
  • Provide guidance, coaching and change expertise to other change resources supporting the program.
About You
  • Demonstrated experience independently leading the end-to-end change management workstream for a Workday implementation.
  • Strong knowledge of Workday and an understanding of the people, process and organisational impacts of implementing an enterprise HRIS.
  • Proven experience leading major technology or business process change across an organisation.
  • Strong stakeholder engagement and relationship management skills.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, including the ability to create clear and engaging content.
  • Strong change impact assessment, readiness and adoption experience.
  • Exceptional interpersonal skills with the ability to influence, negotiate and provide clear advice and support.
  • Strong problem-solving, judgement and attention to detail.
  • Experienced user of Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel and PowerPoint.
Desirable
  • Experience delivering change within an HR transformation.
  • Prosci certification or equivalent change management qualification.
  • Formal project management qualifications or experience.
  • Experience in HR, training or communications.
 
If you have strong Workday change management experience and are looking for an opportunity to contribute to a major transformation program, we would love to hear from you.

job.title: Draftsperson
job.description:
Our manufacturing client is looking for Draftsperson in Melbourne on contract basis.
Role Purpose:

To prepare accurate 2D and 3D technical drawings, models and manufacturing documentation for doors, frames and wall systems.
The role supports production, project delivery and technical teams by converting customer, project and engineering requirements into clear, production-ready drawings, bills of materials and related drafting outputs using SolidWorks, AutoCAD and approved drafting systems.

Responsibilities:
  • Prepare accurate 2D and 3D technical drawings, models and manufacturing documentation for doors, frames and wall systems across the assigned portfolio.
  • Use SolidWorks, AutoCAD and approved drafting systems to convert customer, architectural, project and engineering requirements into production-ready outputs.
  • Interpret specifications, drawings and technical information to identify drafting requirements, constraints and information gaps before release to manufacture.
  • Prepare and validate bills of materials, cutting lists and related production documentation based on approved drawings and manufacturing requirements.
  • Apply sound drafting judgement to ensure drawings are accurate, complete, manufacturable and aligned to product, quality and process standards.
  • Prepare accurate drawing outputs and related data to support CNC, press brake and other manufacturing programming requirements.
  • Identify and raise technical, drawing or specification queries with relevant stakeholders, and support resolution before work proceeds.
  • Work with production and quality teams to investigate drawing-related errors, resolve manufacturing issues and reduce repeat defects.
  • Maintain accurate drafting records, drawing revisions and document control in line with business requirements.
  • Provide practical drafting support across multiple business units or product lines, balancing accuracy, production priorities and manufacturing feasibility.
Technical skills & Knowledge:
  • Strong capability in SolidWorks and AutoCAD, with the ability to produce accurate 2D and 3D manufacturing drawings and models.
  • Experience preparing technical drawings for doors, frames, wall systems or similar manufactured building products.
  • Strong ability to interpret architectural drawings, customer specifications, engineering information and manufacturing requirements.
  • Practical understanding of manufacturing processes, materials, tolerances, fabrication methods and installation considerations.
  • Ability to prepare and validate bills of materials, cutting lists, drawing revisions and production documentation.
  • Strong spatial awareness and attention to detail, with the ability to identify drawing, specification or manufacturability issues before release to production.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently, manage competing drafting priorities and apply sound judgement in a manufacturing environment.
  • Clear communication and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to resolve technical queries with production, project, engineering and quality teams.
If that matches please apply through ad.

job.title: Business Analyst
job.description:

About the Role
 
The Business Analyst will work with business and project stakeholders to define business problems, understand current and future-state processes, elicit and document requirements, assess options and support delivery outcomes.
 
Key activities will include:
  • Documenting business requirements and assessment criteria in a controlled Requirements Register.
  • Analysing and mapping the BMP assessment process, including evidence requirements, decision points and governance controls.
  • Working with assessors, Legal, leadership and other stakeholders to support engagement and prototype design.
  • Supporting testing and validation activities.
  • Developing the assessment guide and approved Copilot prompt library.
  • Supporting scope clarification, risks, dependencies, decisions and delivery activities.
  • Developing and maintaining BA artefacts including requirements, process maps, user stories, acceptance criteria and decision records.
About You
 
To be successful in this role, you will have:
  • Demonstrated experience working as a Business Analyst across projects.
  • Strong experience in requirements elicitation, process analysis, process mapping and stakeholder engagement.
  • Experience developing clear and fit-for-purpose business analysis documentation.
  • Strong ability to work with Project Managers, business owners, SMEs, technology teams, vendors and senior stakeholders.
  • Strong communication, problem-solving and stakeholder influencing skills.
  • Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities and operate effectively in an ambiguous and evolving environment.
  • Experience supporting project planning, risks, dependencies and delivery outcomes.
  • A degree in Business, IT, Business Analysis, Project Management or a related discipline, or equivalent demonstrated experience.
Desirable: Experience working within a government, regulatory or public sector environment, as well as Business Analysis certification or training such as IIBA, CBAP, Agile Business Analysis or BABOK-aligned training.

job.title: Technical Writer
job.description:
Our electrical and communications services industry client is looking for Technical writer in Melbourne on FTC basis.

Key Responsibilities / Accountabilities
  • Write and format inspection and test plans to a single agreed SME standard.
  • Build the master ITP library so that inspection points, evidence requirements and acceptance criteria are consistent across projects.
  • Interview site teams to capture how tasks are actually performed.
  • Convert proven work methods into standard operating procedures with named owners, revision control and review dates.
  • Source acceptance criteria from project specifications, drawings and Australian Standards, and quote the values within the document.
  • Tailor generic ITPs and SOPs to contract requirements and project risks ahead of mobilisation.
  • Apply document numbering, revision control and approval workflow so that every document is traceable.
  • Maintain the document register and keep superseded versions clearly marked.
  • Incorporate review comments from the Quality Manager, engineering and site supervision.
  • Update ITPs and SOPs when non-conformances and lessons learned identify a gap.
  • Prepare supporting material such as visual work guides and pre-start aids where they improve uptake on site.
Key Capabilities / Experience
Essential
  • Strong technical writing skills, with the ability to write plainly for a site audience and keep instructions short enough to be used on the tools.
  • Experience producing controlled documents under revision and approval control.
  • Confidence interviewing tradespeople and supervisors to draw out how work is really done, and the judgement to push past vague answers.
  • Advanced Microsoft Word: templates, styles, numbering, tables and cross-references applied consistently across a large document set.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Excel for maintaining registers and trackers.
  • Organised and self-directed, able to run a document programme to agreed deadlines with minimal supervision.
  • Attention to detail, particularly with numeric acceptance criteria, hold and witness points, and cross-references between documents.
Desirable
  • Experience writing inspection and test plans, checklists or quality forms in a construction, manufacturing or utilities setting.
  • Familiarity with electrical installation work and the terminology used on site.
  • Ability to produce simple visual aids such as annotated photographs, sketches and single-page field guides.
  • Ability to read drawings, specifications and Australian Standards and pull firm requirements out of them, including numeric acceptance criteria
Qualifications / Certifications
Required
  • Demonstrated experience in technical writing, documentation or procedure development.
  • Construction Industry General Safety Induction (White Card), or willingness to obtain one before attending site.
  • Current Australian driver’s licence, with the ability to travel between project sites.
If that suits please apply through this ad.

job.title: Training Consultant - WalkMe

You will work closely with Training, Change, Business Readiness and L&D teams to quickly understand new systems and business processes and translate these into effective in-system guidance and learning support.

We are looking for someone with a strong learning background who can also support broader training activities when required, including developing learning materials and facilitating training.

About You
  • Has hands-on experience with digital adoption platforms, ideally WalkMe
  • Understands how digital adoption platforms work
  • Can troubleshoot issues when required
  • Learns new technology quickly
  • Understands how people learn and adopt new ways of working
  • Can translate complex processes into simple, practical and user-friendly guidance
  • Has strong stakeholder engagement and communication skills
  • Can work independently while collaborating effectively with business and technology teams

job.title: Project Manager

job.title: Programmer / Scheduler - Primavera P6
job.description:

This is a hands-on role suited to someone who enjoys working across multiple projects and contractors, with responsibility for developing robust, resource-loaded programmes and providing accurate reporting to support project delivery and commercial outcomes.

You will be responsible for:
  • Developing, updating and maintaining Primavera P6 programmes across multiple concurrent projects
  • Building and managing resource-loaded schedules, ensuring resource allocation and forecasting remain accurate

  • Monitoring critical paths, programme logic, milestones and schedule performance

You'll ideally bring:

  • Experience working across construction, infrastructure or engineering projects
  • A solid understanding of critical path methodology, programme logic and schedule analysis
  • Experience developing Power BI reporting from P6 data
